title: Which Meals Are Gathered into One Charge to Pay
content:
The meals gathered into a single charge to an employee's pay are taken over a stretch of the Employee Meal Account's ledger that follows the payroll cycle the account is recovered on and whether a charge has lately been accrued.

**Clause.** Where the account is recovered on a weekly or a biweekly cycle and a charge has been accrued on it in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the meals carried are those rung against payroll in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked. Where the account is recovered on a semimonthly or a monthly cycle and a charge has been accrued on it in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the meals carried are those rung against payroll in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked. Where neither holds, the meals carried are every meal rung against payroll on the account to date.

## The three stretches

| Payroll cycle the account is recovered on | A charge accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | Meals rung against payroll are summed over |
|---|---|---|
| Weekly or biweekly | At least one | The calendar month running back from the day the account is worked |
| Semimonthly or monthly | At least one | The three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked |
| Weekly or biweekly | None | The whole ledger to date |
| Semimonthly or monthly | None | The whole ledger to date |

Only meals rung against payroll are summed; meals met from stored value or from employer allowance are not among them, and the count that decides the band is of charges accrued rather than of meals.

*Hypothetical illustration.* An account recovered on a weekly cycle with 2 charges accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked carries the meals rung against payroll in that month, say $88.00. The same account with no charge accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked carries every meal rung against payroll to date, say $640.00.
